title: Mold Remediation Terms: Dispute Window, Goodwill Cap, Cancellation and Warranty Periods
content:
Each Mold Remediation tier sets the customer's dispute window and goodwill ceiling, the cancellation notice and fee, and the two warranty periods. Values per tier:

| Item | Spot | Limited | Standard | Extensive | Attic and Crawlspace | HVAC System |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Billing dispute window (calendar days after invoice date) | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Goodwill credit cap per job (USD) | 75.00 | 150.00 | 250.00 | 400.00 | 250.00 | 250.00 |
| Cancellation notice (calendar days before scheduled start) | 2 | 2 | 3 | 5 | 3 | 3 |
| Late cancellation fee (USD) | 95.00 | 150.00 | 250.00 | 450.00 | 275.00 | 250.00 |
| Remediation warranty (calendar days after cleared date) | 90 | 180 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 180 |
| Secondary damage warranty (calendar days after water job drying complete date) | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |

### Terms defined

- **Billing dispute window**: the days after the final invoice date within which a billing-error or duplicate-line dispute may be credited; 60 days on every tier.
- **Goodwill credit cap**: the maximum total goodwill credit the desk may post on one job.
- **Cancellation notice**: the calendar days before the scheduled start date by which a cancellation avoids the late cancellation fee.
- **Late cancellation fee**: the fee for cancelling a scheduled job after the notice deadline.
- **Remediation warranty**: the days after the cleared date during which visible regrowth in the remediated area is re-remediated at no charge.
- **Secondary damage warranty**: the days after a company water job reached the dry standard during which mold growth in the dried area is remediated at no charge; 60 days on every tier.

### Reading the table

The goodwill cap, the cancellation notice, the late cancellation fee and the remediation warranty differ by tier; the dispute window and the secondary damage warranty do not. Extensive Mold Remediation carries the longest notice, 5 calendar days, and the highest late cancellation fee, 450.00; Spot Mold Remediation carries the shortest remediation warranty, 90 days.
